prompts.title: Continue setup
prompts.template: Resume my Claw Me onboarding session. Ask only the next server-provided question, show no more than three choices, and stop for human approval, payment, OAuth, or secrets.

prompts.title: Review approved context
prompts.template: Read my approved private Claw Me Profile context and summarize the facts most relevant to {{topic}}. Cite the claims used and flag conflicts or stale facts.
prompts.outcome: A cited summary using approved claims only.

prompts.title: Propose a Profile context update
prompts.template: Prepare an owner-reviewed Claw Me Profile context proposal for: {{information}}. Include provenance and rationale; do not approve it.

prompts.title: Keep my Agent current
prompts.template: Create or update one daily cron job in my Agent runtime to check GET https://claw.me/api/v1/claw-me/wiki/agent-guide/status with my existing scoped Claw Me authorization and If-None-Match. Fetch the full Agent Guide only when the ETag changes. Add jitter and backoff, never create duplicates, and notify me only about material changes, conflicts, required review, or authorization failure.
prompts.outcome: One low-frequency, change-aware private context refresh job.

prompts.title: Inspect a workspace
prompts.template: Open Claw Me Drive workspace {{workspace}} and summarize its instructions, current revision, and files without changing anything.

prompts.title: Prepare file changes
prompts.template: Prepare a reviewed change set in Claw Me Drive workspace {{workspace}} for: {{instruction}}. Preview the diff and submit it for owner review; do not merge it.

prompts.title: Publish privately
prompts.template: Prepare these files as a private Claw Me Page named {{title}}. Confirm the slug and file manifest, publish an immutable version, and keep visibility private.

prompts.title: Review a Page
prompts.template: Inspect my Claw Me Page {{page}} and report its visibility, current version, sharing grants, and configuration needing owner attention.

prompts.title: Plan a domain connection
prompts.template: Prepare the DNS and ownership steps needed to connect {{domain}} to Claw Me Page {{page}}. Do not request DNS credentials or change public traffic.
prompts.outcome: A domain proposal and human DNS handoff.

prompts.title: Check channel readiness
prompts.template: Inspect my authorized Claw Me channels and report readiness, missing owner steps, and pending verification without revealing credentials or message contents.

prompts.title: Prepare a channel
prompts.template: Prepare an owner-reviewed setup proposal for {{channel}}. Use secure human handoffs for OAuth, credentials, numbers, and paid actions.
prompts.outcome: A channel proposal with secure owner steps.

prompts.title: Review Page performance
prompts.template: Review the last 30 days of first-party Claw Me Page analytics. Compare views and visitors by Page, identify meaningful changes, and do not infer identities from privacy-preserving data.

prompts.title: Suggest Page improvements
prompts.template: Use my Claw Me Page structure and first-party analytics to suggest up to three improvements for {{goal}}. Explain the evidence and prepare no changes unless I ask.
prompts.outcome: Up to three evidence-based Page recommendations.

prompts.title: Review recent meeting notes
prompts.template: Review my recent Claw Me meeting notes in Drive and summarize decisions, open questions, and overdue action items. Do not expose recordings or invite anyone.

prompts.title: Prepare a note taker
prompts.template: Prepare a Claw Me note-taker proposal for {{meeting}}. Confirm destination Agent, recording storage, and required participant consent; do not join until I approve.

prompts.title: Plan a Page Function
prompts.template: Plan a private Claw Me Page Function for {{task}}. Separate code from configuration, classify required Variables, and prepare a reviewable implementation without publishing it.
prompts.outcome: A reviewable Function and configuration plan.

prompts.title: Audit Function configuration
prompts.template: Inspect the Functions attached to Claw Me Page {{page}} and report missing routes, Variables, or owner decisions. Never reveal secret values.

prompts.title: Plan configuration
prompts.template: Prepare the Claw Me Variables needed for {{task}}, classified as public, private, or secret. Never ask for secret values in chat.

prompts.title: Connect this Agent
prompts.template: Connect this Agent to Claw Me with owner-approved device authorization. Request only the scopes needed for {{task}}, then verify a read-only action.

prompts.title: Audit Agent access
prompts.template: Review my Claw Me Agent authorizations and summarize active clients, scopes, recent use, and credentials that appear stale. Do not revoke anything.

prompts.title: Explain my options
prompts.template: Read the current Claw Me billing catalog and explain the plans, Managed OpenClaw add-on, wallet, and relevant limits for {{goal}}. Do not rely on remembered prices.

prompts.title: Prepare a wallet load
prompts.template: Prepare a Claw Me wallet-funding quote for {{amount}} USD. Explain that funds are closed-loop and require explicit payment approval. Do not pay yet.
